records.title: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
aliases: Central Sector Scholarship for College and University Students
records.summary: A merit-cum-means scholarship for students pursuing regular higher education after Class 12.
records.description: The Department of Higher Education provides financial assistance toward day-to-day expenses for meritorious students pursuing higher studies.
eligibility_text: Above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant Class 12 stream of the applicable board
Annual family income up to Rs 4.5 lakh for the 2025-26 fresh-application guidance
Pursuing a regular course in a recognised college or institution, not correspondence or distance mode
Not receiving another scholarship or fee-reimbursement scheme
benefits: Financial assistance toward day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher education
expectations: Renewal and award conditions must be checked for the applicable academic year

application.method: Online through the National Scholarship Portal
application.deadline_note: The portal publishes a separate schedule for each academic year; no current deadline was stated in the reviewed scheme FAQ.

records.title: Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for Scheduled Caste Students
aliases: Top Class Education for SC Students
records.summary: Financial support for Scheduled Caste students pursuing full-time studies beyond Class 12 in notified institutions.
records.description: The scheme promotes quality higher education for Scheduled Caste students through financial support in institutions notified by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment.

government_entity.name: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
government_entity.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

eligibility_text: Applicant belongs to a Scheduled Caste
Admission to a full-time prescribed course beyond Class 12 in a notified institution
Total annual family income from all sources up to Rs 8 lakh
Award is subject to institution-wise scholarship slots and inter-se merit when demand exceeds slots
benefits: Financial support under the scheme guidelines for study in a notified institution
expectations: Meet institution and National Scholarship Portal verification requirements

application.method: Online through the National Scholarship Portal
application.deadline_note: Check the National Scholarship Portal schedule for the applicable academic year.

sources.title: Central Sector Scholarship of Top Class Education for SC Students
sources.publisher: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

records.title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students — Technical Degree
records.summary: A scholarship for eligible girl students entering an AICTE-approved degree-level technical course.
records.description: The Pragati scheme supports eligible girl students admitted to the first year of a technical degree course or the second year through lateral entry.

government_entity.name: All India Council for Technical Education

eligibility_text: Applicant identifies as female
Studying in the first year of a degree-level course or second year through lateral entry
Institution is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education
Annual family income from all sources up to Rs 8 lakh
Not receiving another Central, State or AICTE scholarship or other financial assistance during the course
No more than two siblings have already received this scholarship
benefits: Scholarship assistance under the applicable AICTE Pragati guidelines
expectations: Institution and course must remain eligible under the current academic-year notice

application.method: Online through the National Scholarship Portal when the academic-year window opens
application.deadline_note: The reviewed eligibility engine did not state the current application deadline.

records.title: Principal — Education Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
records.summary: Union Public Service Commission recruitment for 124 permanent Principal posts in Delhi's Education Department.
records.description: The Head of School is responsible for administrative, academic and financial work and coordinates school activities.
records.job_description: Plan, organise and coordinate the administrative, academic and financial work of a recognised school as Head of School.

government_entity.name: Education Department, Government of NCT of Delhi

eligibility_text: Master's degree from a recognised university or institute
Bachelor of Education from a recognised university or institute
Ten years of teaching experience as Vice Principal, Post Graduate Teacher or Trained Graduate Teacher in a recognised school or college
Maximum age 50 for unreserved/economically weaker section, 53 for Other Backward Class and 55 for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe, with applicable disability relaxation
benefits: Pay Level 12 under the Seventh Central Pay Commission
Permanent General Central Service Group A Gazetted, Non-Ministerial post

job_details.selection_process: Combined recruitment test followed by interview

expectations: Combined recruitment test followed by interview as specified in the notice
documents_required: Degree and Bachelor of Education certificates
Category or disability certificate where applicable
Signature in the prescribed upload format

application.method: Union Public Service Commission Online Recruitment Application
application.deadline_note: Online application closes at 18:00 Indian Standard Time on 14 August 2026.

Permanent General Central Service Group A Gazetted, Non-Ministerial post

job_details.selection_process: Combined recruitment test followed by interview

documents_required: Degree and Bachelor of Education certificates
